router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED gate determinism'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.gate:
name: ${{ matrix.name }} (fmt, build, units, CLI e2e)
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - {name: linux x86-64, os: ubuntu-latest, arch: x86_64}
          - {name: macOS arm64, os: macos-latest, arch: arm64}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: runner temporary files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test "$(uname -m)" = '${{ matrix.arch }}'
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/paxage"
          echo "TMPDIR=${RUNNER_TEMP}/paxage" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: digest-pinned wolf and lupin
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: Complete platform-aware payload and trust gates
        run: bash tools/gauntlet
      - name: Preserve deterministic payload even while RSS is blocked
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: canonical-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: target/evidence/canonical.payload.tar
          if-no-files-found: error
ci.yml.determinism:
name: Cross-host four-payload byte identity
    needs: gate
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: canonical-*
      - name: Compare the per-host identical pairs byte for byte
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cmp canonical-arm64/canonical.payload.tar canonical-x86_64/canonical.payload.tar
          sha256sum canonical-arm64/canonical.payload.tar canonical-x86_64/canonical.payload.tar
          echo 'END F6-cross-host-determinism exit=0'
